title: Scan counter, feedback prompts and a tidier layout
summary: See how many scans travelers have run, tell us how an export went, and a home page that fits your screen.

changes.text: Scan counter at the bottom of the home page: how many scans travelers have run with GI Helper. Hover it for screenshots, video and AI Vision separately.
After you export to GOOD, GI Helper asks how the scan went, with a button that opens the feedback form right there. It won't ask more than every few days, or soon after you've sent feedback.
The home page no longer scrolls into empty space below the scanner.
On phones, pages no longer scroll a little extra behind the browser's address bar.
On phones, the Home, Inventory and Materials links have their own row under the logo, with their names shown.
The Feedback page opens right away and loads the posts after, with placeholders while they arrive.
Your data on the About page now mentions the scan counter: only the scanner type is sent, never your screenshots or results.
The footer links are a pill like the top bar's, and show which page you're on.
Clearing your inventory and deleting messages ask for confirmation in the app's own glass dialog instead of the browser's pop-up.
Pages show glass placeholders in the site's style while they load.
